text: The RWB-E6-028 harness runs in SIT against fakes generated from the published contracts of rwb-writeoff, rwb-decision, rwb-case, rwb-debtsale, rwb-source-data and rwb-access, on the synthetic population of three cases RW-2027-000728 to RW-2027-000730 with the write-offs WO-SYN-000728 to WO-SYN-000730 for cut-off month 2027-04 and business date 2027-04-30, two amounts inside the write-off committee limit and one above it, with the stubs in place from Day 1 and the real services replacing them as RWB-S7-E6028-APP and RWB-P7-E6028-APP land, and with the S6 hop kept as a contract fake reported as a fake hop until the S6 lot stories land.
why: No source read specifies the harness environment, the fixture layout, the synthetic keys, the amounts and the limit, the business date, the evidence retention or the gate, and the wave cannot wait for them without an approved value; the Ownership Map also publishes no write-off read and no write-off sale operation, so the population and the handover need a ruling before the harness is built.
